Make the laying matrix

Source: R/egg_laying.R
make_U_matrix.Rd

Make the egg laying matrix \((\mathbf {U})\).

Usage

make_U_matrix(search_weights, habitat_matrix, Q)

Arguments

search_weights

the habitat search weights

habitat_matrix

the habitat membership matrix

Q

the availability of egg-laying habitats

Value

an nHabitats \(\times\) nPatches matrix describing egg distribution, \(U\)

Habitat Matrix

The habitat matrix \((\mathbf N)\) is an nPatches\(\times\)nHabitats matrix that is constructed from the habitat_vector.

If the \(i^{th}\) habitat is in the \(j^{th}\) patch, then \({N}_{j,i}=1.\) Otherwise, \({N}_{j,i}=0.\)

If \(x\) is any vector describing a quantity in habitats (i.e., \(\left|x\right|=\)nHabitats), then $$X=\mathbf{N}\cdot x$$ is a vector that has summed \(x\) by patch, and \(\left|X\right|=\)nPatches.

Habitat Availability

Egg laying by adult mosquitoes was modeled as the outcome of searching for aquatic habitats.

Each habitat is assigned a search weight \((w).\)

Habitat availability in a patch is the sum of the search weights of all the habitats in that patch.

Habitat availability \((Q)\) is computed using the habitat matrix \((\mathbf{N})\):

$$Q = \mathbf{N}\cdot w$$

  • Patch emigration rates and egg laying rates by adult mosquitoes can be modeled as a functional response to habitat availability.

Laying Matrix

The egg laying matrix \((\mathbf {U})\) distributes the eggs laid by the adult mosquitoes in each patch among the aquatic habitats in that patch by relative availability.

The algorithm is motivated by searching for aquatic habitat. Each habitat is assigned a search weight \((w).\) Habitat availability \((Q)\) sums the search weights by patch. Of the eggs laid in productive habitats in the \(j^{th}\) patch, the fraction laid in the \(i^{th}\) habitat is \(w_i / Q_j.\)

This is computed by constructing the laying matrix, \(\mathbf U\), an nHabitats \(\times\) nPatches matrix. To avoid division-by-zero errors for patches with no available habitats, a quantity \(\epsilon = 1e-14\) is added to availability: $$ \mathbf{U}= \mbox{diag}\left( w \right) \cdot \mathbf{N}^T \cdot \mbox{diag} \left( \frac{1}{\textstyle{Q + \epsilon}} \right) $$

See also

The membership matrix \(N\) is computed by make_habitat_matrix

Total habitat availability, \(Q\), is computed by F_available_habitat

The availability of ovitraps and bad habitats is set up in setup_egg_laying_interface
